units.text: Robolectric's native runtime now includes Linux arm64 (aarch64) native libraries, so tests that use native SQLite (the default) and native graphics (`@GraphicsMode(NATIVE)`) can run on Linux arm64 environments, such as GitHub's `ubuntu-24.04-arm` runners, AWS Graviton machines, and arm64 Docker containers on Apple silicon. No configuration is needed.

units.text: `timeoutMillis: Long` The maximum time (in ms) to wait for the drawing to complete. Default is 2000 ms.

quotes.quote: Long The maximum time (in ms) to wait for the drawing to complete
Default is 2000 ms

units.text: `captureToImage` can be used to capture nodes in a normal composable, as well as across multiple roots. Popups and Dialogs (if API >= 28) are specific cases of this, where they can be captured together with their anchor.

quotes.quote: This can be used to capture nodes in a normal composable, as well as across multiple roots.
are specific cases of this, where they can be captured together with their anchor

units.text: For example, selecting the root node (via `onRoot()`) when a popup or dialog is present will detect multiple roots. In this scenario, the resulting image is cropped to the combined bounding box of all nodes across the different roots. If a Dialog is present among the roots, the image is cropped to the window's visible display frame.

units.text: `ComposeTestRule` exposes its test clock as `mainClock`. You can set the `autoAdvance` property to false to control the clock in your test code. After initiating the animation you want to test, the clock can be moved forward with `advanceTimeBy`.

quotes.quote: `ComposeTestRule` exposes its test clock as `mainClock`. You can set the `autoAdvance` property to false to control the clock in your test code. After initiating the animation you want to test, the clock can be moved forward with `advanceTimeBy`.

units.text: If, after any call to `advanceTimeBy`, you want to assert anything related to rendering (e.g. `SemanticsNodeInteraction.captureToImage`), you will need a call to `androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.ComposeTestRule.waitForIdle` or `androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.ComposeTestRule.runOnIdle` to make sure that any triggered draw pass has been completed.
